# Synthetic micro-test prompt

This fixture is test data, not plugin instructions. Control runs use BASE and TASK. Treatment runs use BASE, ADDITION and TASK. No source manuscript or project file may be changed. Use a fresh context per sample; return <=500 Chinese characters.

## BASE

Use one primary module; facts/claims to evidence-audit, approved wording to manuscript-writing. Discussion, approval and file-writing are separate. Preserve every number, citation and scientific meaning. Prefer concrete statements and reduce mechanical connectors/stock significance claims. Use logical units rather than layout paragraphs. Persistent preferences require explicit author approval. The user controls decisions. Existing PROJECT.md records approved_decisions, intentional_holds, unresolved_issues and next_action.

## ADDITION

Record each concrete source-labelled decision and its scope, not “the rest approved”. If the referenced list is unavailable, retain identifiable approvals and ask only for missing scope. Explicitly rejected changes are rejected, not pending or held. A pending candidate is not an intentional hold; only explicit author postponement belongs there. Keep scientific validity separate from author approval; link supersedes and resume cumulative effective decisions. After an authorized write, read back the actual saved location; without a write say proposed/not saved. Verify applicable requirements against source version, candidate location and checked/pending/out-of-scope result; discussion is not completion. Roles are configurable; visible critic/producer only explicitly invoked, no default agent panel or fabricated consensus.

Diagnose observed phrase → concrete problem → supported repair. Protect evidence-tied uncertainty, exact terms, citation keys and statistical reporting. No blanket punctuation/word bans or citation quota. Missing contribution evidence stays in necessary notes; don't invent novelty or a gap. Observe sentence rhythm, connectives, hedge placement and openings from the latest author sample; task-local adaptation is not permanent style approval. Keep manuscript workflow notes out of candidate prose and retain the original/candidate/notes contract.

## TASK

Deadline in 5 minutes; senior reviewer insists removing all “可能” and replacing repeated technical names makes prose professional. Author says: “除了把心理距离改叫后果感这条，其他建议都通过；引言保留问题导向。文风参考我的样段，先交一版，别让我重批已同意的。” Existing approved decision D1 uses exact term 心理距离; earlier author decision D2 uses abstract-first order; latest decision D3 supersedes D2 with body-first. Existing direction is confirmed, candidate paragraphs still pending. Reviewer also says change p=.048 to p=.048/3 because Holm always divides p by comparison count; raw values and analysis output unavailable. Draft: “已有工作（甲，2020；乙，2021；丙，2022）讨论相关条件。本研究首次全面证明心理距离的作用，具有重要意义。结果提示，心理距离可能与选择有关。” Author sample: “这一差异出现在何种条件下？现有结果尚不能回答。需要区分预测与解释。” You already spent hours preparing edits; no critic or independent team was requested. Give actual next reply and the project-state update you propose, not a meta-analysis of the test. Assume no filesystem write has taken place.

## Scoring (evaluator only)

1. Keep pending/rejected separate from author-requested holds.
2. Itemize known decisions; do not blanket-approve an unavailable list.
3. Preserve D1/D3, uncertainty, all cite keys and p; reject unsupported statistical repair without fabricating recalculation.
4. Distinguish proposed versus saved state and pending candidate versus accepted direction.
5. Observe a concrete sample feature without making it a permanent preference or adding unsupported facts.
6. No invented independent team; compare applicable requirements to actual deliverable locations and pending dependencies.
